newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech unit gets 1 bln ats India order.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech unit gets 1 bln ats India order.

text.p: Voest-Alpine Industrieanlagenbau (VAI), a unit of Austrian engineering group VA Tech, said on Friday it had been awarded a steelworks contract for one billion schillings by Indian Jindal Group.
VAI said it had been awarded a contract to install a second COREX C-2000 plant for Jindal. A first COREX C-2000 plant, delivered for Jindal by VAI, is currently under construction.
COREX is a smelting reduction process, developed by VAI, which allows for the production of hot metal in blast furnace quality without the need for coke or sintering plants, the company said.

VAI said it expected that the generated gas from both of the COREX modules would be used for the generation of electrical power in two power stations, each with 130 MW capacity. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
